answer: Passive acoustic attestation resists Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to physical soundscapes. Nodes authenticate by measuring time-difference-of-arrival for ambient sounds, such as a raven calling across a grove toward the horizon. Because acoustic wavefronts cannot be forged across separate vantage points, an attacker must deploy dedicated microphone hardware and secure distinct real estate per persona. However, irregular acoustic events limit verification throughput.
